changelog:
2.4.0

  • Staff terms of use: before a login can send, the person reads the client's terms and ticks "I agree". The plugin records who agreed, when, from which IP address and the exact wording; editing the wording asks everyone again. Enforced on the server, not just the screen.
  • Settings > Limits shows every sending login and whether they have agreed.
  • Uninstall removes the agreement records.
